values.note: The FS page says sites take tents, trailers and RVs up to 22 feet long. recreation.gov lists 12 sites (6 reservable); the FS page says 13 (5 reservable). Some sites lost their shade to hazard-tree removal.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/hinman-park-campground ('Campsites can accommodate tents, trailers and RVs up to 22 feet long'; 'has 13 single-family campsites'; '5 campsites that are reservable and 8 sites that are first come, first served') + recreation.gov 10168473 ('There are 12 campsites, 6 of which may be reserved'; catalog 12 sites, 6 reservable, no lengths), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No water and no cell service. Trash collection.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/hinman-park-campground ('There are 2 vault toilets, but there is no water or cell service in the area') + recreation.gov amenities (Trash Collection, Vault Toilets; notice 'No water available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Early June to mid-September (FS); the 2026 recreation.gov season ran June 1 - Sept 19.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/hinman-park-campground ('Seasons of Use: Early June - Mid September') + recreation.gov /rates (2026 Peak 06-01 to 09-07, FCFS 09-08 to 09-19), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Half the sites reservable; the rest first-come. On-site payment is exact cash or check only.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10168473 ('12 campsites, 6 of which may be reserved. Remaining sites are first-come, first-served') + /rates (2026 Peak 2026-06-01 to 09-07) + FS page ('camping is limited to 14 days'; 'Must have exact change if paying cash, or pay by check unless previously reserved on recreation.gov'), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10168473/rates (2026 Peak PeakStandardNonelectric 14; 2026 FCFS 14) + FS page ('Single Site: $14 per night'), read 2026-10-28

note: Routt NF campground at ~7,600 ft near the Elk River, 22 mi north of Steamboat Springs and a gateway to the Mount Zirkel Wilderness: County Road 129 north, County Road 64/60 (Seedhouse Road, FR 400) northeast 6 mi, then Forest Road 440 (Reed Creek Road) south across the South Fork bridge about 1/4 mi. --Claude
